zh.title: 外媒稱巴拉圭擬引進AT-3及F-5 外交部表示不評論
zh.summary: 外媒報導巴拉圭洽談引進AT-3與F-5；外交部表示不評論軍事事務。
body: 外媒報導指出，台灣友邦巴拉圭正與台灣洽談引進F-5戰機與AT-3教練機，評估重建中斷20多年的噴射戰力，預計自2027年起引進10至15架。台灣外交部對此回應表示，雙方政府長期維持各領域交流合作，但對於相關報導，外交部一貫不評論涉及友邦國防及軍事事務。
在機隊現狀方面，台灣空軍F-5型戰機已於去年7月除役，AT-3教練機則於今年7月底完成最後一批飛行任務，由勇鷹新式高級教練機接棒。學者與專家分析，若巴拉圭引進AT-3，將有助於強化其國防戰力，後勤維修作業預計將由漢翔公司負責並提供技術支援。

en.title: Foreign Media Report Paraguay Seeking AT-3 and F-5 Aircraft; MOFA Declines Comment
en.summary: Foreign media report Paraguay is evaluating acquiring Taiwanese AT-3 and F-5 aircraft; Taiwan MOFA declines comment.
body: Foreign media reported that Paraguay is in talks with Taiwan to evaluate acquiring F-5 fighter jets and AT-3 trainer aircraft to rebuild its jet capabilities, expecting to introduce 10 to 15 aircraft starting in 2027. Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded that the two governments maintain long-term cooperation across various fields, but stated it consistently does not comment on matters concerning the defense and military affairs of allies.

Taiwan's F-5 fighters were retired in July last year, while AT-3 trainer aircraft completed their final flight missions at the end of July this year, being replaced by the Brave Eagle advanced jet trainer. Experts noted that if Paraguay acquires AT-3 aircraft, it could bolster its defense capabilities, with logistics and maintenance expected to be handled by Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation (AIDC).

zh.title: 美空軍C-17A運輸機據報自拉脫維亞飛抵莫斯科
zh.summary: 美空軍C-17A飛抵莫斯科；自拉脫維亞起飛；軍方未說明任務目的
body: 根據航班追蹤數據，美國空軍（USAF）一架波音 C-17A 環球霸王III運輸機於2026年8月25日上午，自拉脫維亞的里加國際機場（RIX）飛抵俄羅斯莫斯科伏努科沃國際機場（VKO）。該架機號為 07-7181 的軍機於8月23日自馬里蘭州安德魯斯聯合基地（ADW）抵達里加。
美俄兩國官方目前均未公開此項軍事飛行任務的具體目的。克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫於8月25日表示，他並未掌握相關資訊，且克里姆林宮當周並未排定與美國政府代表進行任何會晤。

en.title: US Air Force C-17A Globemaster III Flies to Moscow from Latvia
en.summary: A US Air Force C-17A transport aircraft flew from Latvia to Moscow with undisclosed flight purpose.
body: According to flight tracking data, a United States Air Force Boeing C-17A Globemaster III flew from Riga International Airport (RIX) in Latvia to Moscow Vnukovo International Airport (VKO) on August 25, 2026. Tracking records show the aircraft arrived in Riga on August 23, 2026, after departing from Joint Base Andrews (ADW) in Maryland.

Officials from both the United States and Russia have not disclosed the purpose of the military transport flight. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated on August 25, 2026, that he had no information regarding the flight and that no meetings with US administration representatives were scheduled at the Kremlin for the week.

zh.title: Aircalin首架A350客機於土魯斯亮相
zh.summary: Aircalin首架A350-900客機完成塗裝，預計年底交付。
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，Aircalin 的首架空中巴士（Airbus）A350-900 客機，於法國土魯斯（Toulouse）首次亮相。該客機剛出漆裝廠，展示了其具代表性的彩色塗裝。這也是該航空公司向空中巴士訂購的兩架 A350-900 中的第一架。
這架 A350-900 預計將於 2026 年底前交付給 Aircalin，第二架則計劃於 2027 年或 2028 年交付。交付後，新客機將主要投入營運努美阿（NOU）經曼谷（BKK）至巴黎戴高樂機場（CDG）的長途航線。該機型將採用三艙等佈局，配置 325 個座位，包含 32 個商務艙、24 個豪華經濟艙及 269 個經濟艙。

en.title: Aircalin's First Airbus A350-900 Spotted in Toulouse Paint Shop
en.summary: Aircalin's first Airbus A350-900 has been spotted in Toulouse ahead of late 2026 delivery.
body: According to AeroTime, Aircalin’s first Airbus A350-900 has been spotted for the first time in Toulouse, France, fresh out of the paint shop in its iconic colorful livery. This is the first of two A350-900s that the New Caledonia-based carrier has on order from Airbus, with the second aircraft expected to follow in 2027 or 2028.

The first A350-900 is expected to be delivered to Aircalin towards the end of 2026. Once delivered, the aircraft will be deployed on the carrier's long-haul route connecting Noumea (NOU) to Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) via Bangkok (BKK). The aircraft will feature a three-class cabin layout configured with 325 seats, including 32 business class, 24 premium economy, and 269 economy seats.

zh.title: SEMI與台灣高鐵策略合作 展期加開班次並於5站開放現場領證
zh.summary: SEMI宣布與台灣高鐵合作；展期加密班次；於桃園等5站提供現場領證
body: 國際半導體產業協會（SEMI）於2026年8月25日宣布與台灣高鐵展開策略合作，為9月2日登場的國際半導體展（SEMICON Taiwan 2026）提供服務。SEMI估計將有超過10萬名全球半導體專業人士來台參展。
展期期間，台灣高鐵將透過加密班次提升運能，並於桃園、新竹、台中、台南及高雄等5個車站提供現場領證服務，讓國際夥伴快速往返各大科技聚落。
台灣高鐵表示，來自全球65個國家的產業夥伴將可透過高鐵網路深入台灣科技聚落，串聯半導體生態系。

en.title: SEMI Partners With Taiwan High Speed Rail for SEMICON Taiwan 2026
en.summary: SEMI partners with Taiwan High Speed Rail to add services and badge collection across five stations.
body: SEMI announced a strategic partnership with Taiwan High Speed Rail on August 25, 2026, ahead of the SEMICON Taiwan 2026 exhibition scheduled to begin on September 2. SEMI estimates that more than 100,000 global semiconductor professionals will visit Taiwan for the trade show.

During the exhibition, Taiwan High Speed Rail will increase train service frequencies and offer on-site badge collection at five stations, including Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung, enabling international visitors to travel efficiently between key technology hubs.
According to Taiwan High Speed Rail, industry partners from 65 countries will utilize the high-speed rail network to connect directly with Taiwan's semiconductor ecosystem and technology clusters.
